lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good evening, this call is from the Enforcement Directorate regarding a pending investigation against you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your PAN card has been used in a hawala transaction of 68 lakhs. The Supreme Court judge has issued an order for your digital custody.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You are in digital custody now. Disconnecting this call will be treated as escaping from custody.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Install the AnyDesk app so our team can check your accounts for illegal transactions.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: After that you have to break your fixed deposit and deposit the amount for fund verification.
